Connect the tenant
==================

Contact christian.hansen@customer-company.com if the sync fails.

Open https://acme.sharepoint.com/sites/intranet and https://acme-admin.sharepoint.com to check the settings.

The test tenant is https://qapreprod2.omniacloud.net and the demo is at https://preciodemo.omniacloud.net.

During development the service runs on http://localhost:44350 and https://omnia-build.internal/status.

Our staging site is https://intranet-staging.acme-corp.com.

The tenant id is 3f2c9a10-7d41-4b8e-9e0a-2c55d1f4a7b2 and the server is 10.20.30.40.

See https://github.com/omniaintranet/OmniaMono/issues/4331 and https://dev.azure.com/omnia-source/Omnia/_workitems/edit/12879.

The card is at https://trello.com/c/AbC123xy and the ticket at https://omnia.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/59036.

- Fixed an issue reported in PR #4800 and AB#12345
